caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate glass decanter placed centrally on a plain, beige background. The decanter is rendered in shades of gray and subtle blue, emphasizing the transparent and reflective qualities of the glass. The decanter has a round base with a decorative, diamond-cut pattern and a flared foot. Above the base, the body of the decanter is bulbous and smooth, tapering upwards into a long, cylindrical neck adorned with vertical grooves. The neck has a small, flat rim, which holds a round stopper. The stopper is faceted, creating a textured, spherical appearance at the top. At the bottom right of the decanter, the name “GEORGE YANOSKO” is written in small, neat capital letters. The background is unembellished and shows slight signs of wear, including faint marks and discoloration.
title: Decanter
